recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. FHIR-13099 does not need a current source correction; any future replacement of the display-style Confluence URL with the canonical page-id URL should be handled as general link modernization rather than this tracker's unapplied fix.
issue_request: FHIR-13099 was Published/Persuasive for the NamingSystem resource. It reported that the Background and Context guidance for creating well maintained OIDs and URIs linked to a non-existing HL7 wiki page and requested that the guidance link be fixed.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 12845, visible in git as 1d19e907f811c14bc69dcaed7bd54341b564069f, which changed source/namingsystem/namingsystem-introduction.xml from the broken InM_FHIR_homepage wiki URL to the Migrating_OIDs_to_FHIR wiki page. Earlier FHIR-8086 had introduced the NamingSystem policy link in revision 6478.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/namingsystem/namingsystem-introduction.xml remains in current build scope. Later commit dbd08df53eb122db3a7accbc4ac47e87ad999c36 migrated the policy link from the HL7 wiki to the HL7 Confluence site. The indexed Confluence corpus contains a current FHIR-space page titled 'Migrating OIDs to FHIR', and community searches found only the tracker bot notification plus no Jira-specific Confluence references.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current NamingSystem introduction still contains the requested Background and Context guidance and links it to the HL7 Confluence page instead of the non-existing wiki page named in the issue.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-8086 introduced the NamingSystem OID/URI policy link that FHIR-13099 later corrected.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting that NamingSystem's guidance for well maintained OIDs and URIs linked to a non-existing HL7 wiki page.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final request: keep the NamingSystem guidance but repair the broken policy link.

evidence_items.summary: NamingSystem is active in the resource list, and its Background and Context section links OID/URI policy guidance to the HL7 Confluence site.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scoped source already includes the corrected link target for the guidance described by the issue.

evidence_items.summary: Commit '#13099 - fix broken link' changed the NamingSystem link from InM_FHIR_homepage to Migrating_OIDs_to_FHIR.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-13099 was explicitly applied to the relevant source file.

evidence_items.summary: The later wiki-to-Confluence migration changed the NamingSystem guidance link to https://confluence.hl7.org/display/FHIR/Migrating+OIDs+to+FHIR.
evidence_items.learned: The current Confluence target is a later source-history refinement, not an unapplied part of FHIR-13099.

evidence_items.locator: Confluence SQL title lookup for Migrating OIDs to FHIR
evidence_items.command: bun run confluence:search sql "SELECT id, space_key, title, page_kind, status, url, version_when, is_deleted FROM pages WHERE title = 'Migrating OIDs to FHIR' LIMIT 5"
evidence_items.summary: The indexed Confluence corpus contains current FHIR page 35718620 titled 'Migrating OIDs to FHIR'.
evidence_items.learned: The current source points at an existing policy page in the expected Confluence space.

evidence_items.locator: Zulip and Confluence search for FHIR-13099 plus NamingSystem OID/URI terms
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search fts 'GF 13099 NamingSystem' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts 'NamingSystem "well maintained" OIDs URIs' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-13099
evidence_items.summary: Zulip returned only the tracker bot notification and Confluence had no Jira-specific references.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community evidence conflicts with the Jira and source-history conclusion.
